title: Miles Expiry Panic
scenario: A message says your miles expire tonight unless you refresh activity through a link.

answers.A: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.B: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.C: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.
answers.D: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.

explanation: Miles Expiry Panic: the trap is to move you from a trusted channel to a fake page. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: Check expiry dates after logging in directly.
